RFMResponseMetrics.title: RFMResponseMetrics
RFMResponseMetrics.description: Once the RFM analysis flow completes, display the following message to the user: RFM analysis for the specified sales period is now complete. Then prompt the user with: "Would you like to confirm the results by retrieving a few sample records from predefined categories such as 1) Champions 2) Lost Loyalists 3) Steady Spenders and more
